value.rationale: For a natural uniform spanning tree network, conditioning on one particular cross-edge flips independently distributed endpoint degrees into universally negatively correlated monotone statistics. The entire rank-one dependence structure is explicit, and the negative correlation persists at -1/5 in balanced large graphs. This is a meaningful structural conditional assortativity law, stronger than a routine marginal or a single covariance lookup.
